description: Double-entry ledger framework layer — accounts/transactions/entries schema, atomic post_transaction with debit=credit invariant, as-of-timestamp balance query.

buildHints.whenToUse: When you need a production-grade double-entry ledger API: fintech, accounting, payments reconciliation, or any backend that must track money with strict debit=credit invariants.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@host/db pnpm dev` — the server listens on PORT (default 3000) with /health, POST /api/transactions, and GET /api/accounts/:id/balance.
Run `pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate` to create the accounts, transactions, and entries tables in Postgres.
Seed accounts by inserting rows into the accounts table (code, name, type, currency); then POST /api/transactions with at least two balanced entries (one debit, one credit) to verify the ledger.
Run `pnpm validate` to confirm all required files exist and the debit=credit invariant is present in the source.
gotchas: NEVER use JavaScript number (float) for money — 0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3. All arithmetic goes through decimal.js; amounts stored as NUMERIC(20,4) in Postgres.
Debit MUST equal credit per transaction, per currency. postTransaction enforces this before and after insert; the DB transaction rolls back on any mismatch.
Reversing an entry is NOT deleting it — post a new transaction with opposite direction. Audit trail requires immutability.
Idempotency keys are mandatory on external-facing endpoints; a retried POST without one duplicates the posting.
Account balance sign depends on type: asset/expense = debits - credits; liability/equity/income = credits - debits. Getting this backward is the #1 accounting bug.
As-of balance queries filter by posted_at <= asOf, not created_at — backdated corrections are real.
architectureNotes: Every transaction is N entries where sum(debits) == sum(credits) per currency — enforced in src/ledger/post.ts before and after insert.
A single DB transaction wraps every posting; partial inserts leave an unbalanced ledger which is a business-critical corruption.
src/db/schema.ts owns the Drizzle table definitions; src/ledger/post.ts owns the invariant; src/ledger/query.ts owns balance semantics.

Postgres connection using DATABASE_URL env var. Adjust pool size (max) for your expected concurrency.
